boundary: Exploratory articulated geometry test of the complete BodyParts3D skin solid. The full solid's inherited inner-sheet weights are a harmonic extrapolation from the existing outer sheet, not new anatomical measurements. This study does not qualify material, mass, contact, clinical anatomy, or native runtime integration.

candidate.geometry: complete 101691-vertex, 203382-triangle FJ2810 source solid; source positions and faces unchanged
candidate.outer_constraints: retain current ABI5 full-body source weights on every exact-coordinate-matched outer-sheet vertex; repeated seam copies must have identical weights
candidate.inner_extension: one positive graph-Laplacian harmonic extension over the full closed source surface using inverse source-edge length conductance and all outer-sheet vertices as fixed Dirichlet values
candidate.numerics: float64 sparse solve; fail on nonfinite or materially negative weights; clamp only negative roundoff in [-1e-12,0) to zero and renormalize unknown rows; fixed outer rows remain byte-identical
candidate.deformation: source full-body LBS with the current ABI5 body bindings and source model's equality-projected inertial-frame transforms

control: For each pose, compare candidate outer-sheet vertices to the exact retained ABI5 native LBS pack. The candidate outer field must match within 2e-6 m. The full source solid is the zero-intersection, closed-manifold rest control.
experimental_unit: One deterministic pose snapshot; the three kinematic conditions are not independent biological replicates.

fixed_settings.precision: float64 solve/transforms and exact predicate after Float32 geometry emission

prediction: The full source solid remains closed, exactly embedded, and zero-self-intersecting at all three poses, while its retained outer sheet reproduces each native LBS pack within 2e-6 m.
primary_observable: Exact self-intersection pair count and closed oriented manifold status of the complete Float32-deformed source solid; outer-surface native-pack position parity is a required control.
purpose: advance from an open outer-only skin image to articulated testing of the complete source skin surface while preserving the already-retained outer deformation
question: Can the closed BodyParts3D FJ2810 full-surface geometry be carried through the current source LBS field at knee flexion without losing embeddedness, while leaving the existing outer native skin output unchanged?
refutation: Any exact candidate surface intersection, material-position parity error above 2e-6 m, non-closed topology, missing source identity, or failure to extend every binding across one connected graph refutes the preregistered prediction or makes that pose inconclusive.
stopping_rule: Build one deterministic full-surface harmonic weight field, verify its rest reconstruction and exact fixed outer constraints, then run one exact CPU surface predicate at each of the three listed poses; do not tune weights or adopt the candidate from this screen.
